SELECT json_build_object(
  'restaurant_refresh_history_terminal_state',
  to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_runs') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_candidates') IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE((
    SELECT array_agg(attname::text ORDER BY attnum)
    FROM pg_attribute
    WHERE attrelid = to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_runs')
      AND attnum > 0
      AND NOT attisdropped
  ), '{}'::text[]) = ARRAY[
    'id', 'restaurant_id', 'run_type', 'status', 'requested_by_admin_id', 'query',
    'source_snapshot', 'notes', 'started_at', 'completed_at', 'created_at'
  ]::text[]
  AND COALESCE((
    SELECT array_agg(attname::text ORDER BY attnum)
    FROM pg_attribute
    WHERE attrelid = to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_candidates')
      AND attnum > 0
      AND NOT attisdropped
  ), '{}'::text[]) = ARRAY[
    'id', 'restaurant_id', 'run_id', 'candidate_status', 'detected_change_types',
    'previous_snapshot', 'candidate_snapshot', 'evidence', 'operator_decision',
    'operator_notes', 'decided_by_admin_id', 'decided_at', 'applied_at', 'created_at'
  ]::text[]
  AND COALESCE((
    SELECT array_agg(conname::text ORDER BY conname)
    FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_runs')
  ), '{}'::text[]) = ARRAY[
    'restaurant_refresh_runs_pkey',
    'restaurant_refresh_runs_restaurant_id_fkey',
    'restaurant_refresh_runs_run_type_check',
    'restaurant_refresh_runs_status_check'
  ]::text[]
  AND COALESCE((
    SELECT array_agg(conname::text ORDER BY conname)
    FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_candidates')
  ), '{}'::text[]) = ARRAY[
    'restaurant_refresh_candidates_applied_requires_decision_check',
    'restaurant_refresh_candidates_decision_check',
    'restaurant_refresh_candidates_pkey',
    'restaurant_refresh_candidates_restaurant_id_fkey',
    'restaurant_refresh_candidates_run_id_fkey',
    'restaurant_refresh_candidates_status_check'
  ]::text[]
  AND COALESCE((
    SELECT relrowsecurity
    FROM pg_class
    WHERE oid = to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_runs')
  ), false)
  AND COALESCE((
    SELECT relrowsecurity
    FROM pg_class
    WHERE oid = to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_candidates')
  ), false)
  AND to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_runs_restaurant_created_idx') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_runs_status_created_idx') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_candidates_status_created_idx') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_candidates_restaurant_created_idx') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_candidates_change_types_gin_idx') IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE((
    SELECT array_agg(policyname::text ORDER BY policyname)
    FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'restaurant_refresh_runs'
  ), '{}'::text[]) = ARRAY[
    'restaurant_refresh_runs_admin_insert',
    'restaurant_refresh_runs_admin_select',
    'restaurant_refresh_runs_admin_update'
  ]::text[]
  AND COALESCE((
    SELECT array_agg(policyname::text ORDER BY policyname)
    FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'restaurant_refresh_candidates'
  ), '{}'::text[]) = ARRAY[
    'restaurant_refresh_candidates_admin_insert',
    'restaurant_refresh_candidates_admin_select',
    'restaurant_refresh_candidates_admin_update'
  ]::text[]
  AND NOT COALESCE(
    has_table_privilege('anon', to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_runs'), 'select'),
    false
  )
  AND NOT COALESCE(
    has_table_privilege('anon', to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_candidates'), 'select'),
    false
  )
  AND COALESCE(
    has_table_privilege('authenticated', to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_runs'), 'select,insert,update'),
    false
  )
  AND COALESCE(
    has_table_privilege('authenticated', to_regclass('public.restaurant_refresh_candidates'), 'select,insert,update'),
    false
  )
)::text;

SELECT json_build_object(
  'g016_privacy_audit_owner_policy_terminal_state',
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policy p
    JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = p.polrelid
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'privacy_retention' AND c.relname = 'privacy_audit_events'
      AND p.polname = 'g016_privacy_workflow_owner_access'
      AND p.polcmd = '*' AND p.polpermissive
      AND pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid) = 'true'
      AND pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid) = 'true'
      AND p.polroles = ARRAY[(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'privacy_workflow_owner')]::oid[]
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'privacy_retention' AND c.relname = 'privacy_audit_events'
      AND pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) = 'privacy_workflow_owner'
      AND c.relrowsecurity AND c.relforcerowsecurity
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, acldefault('r', c.relowner))) acl
        WHERE acl.grantee = 0 AND acl.privilege_type IN ('SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')
      )
  )
  AND NOT COALESCE(has_table_privilege('anon', 'privacy_retention.privacy_audit_events', 'select,insert,update,delete'), false)
  AND NOT COALESCE(has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'privacy_retention.privacy_audit_events', 'select,insert,update,delete'), false)
  AND NOT COALESCE(has_table_privilege('service_role', 'privacy_retention.privacy_audit_events', 'select,insert,update,delete'), false)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (VALUES
      (COALESCE(to_regprocedure('public.confirm_privacy_onboarding(uuid,text,uuid,text,uuid)'), to_regprocedure('privacy_retention.g014_confirm_privacy_onboarding_legacy(uuid,text,uuid,text,uuid)')), CASE WHEN to_regprocedure('public.confirm_privacy_onboarding(uuid,text,uuid,text,uuid)') IS NOT NULL THEN ARRAY['privacy_workflow_owner','service_role']::text[] ELSE ARRAY['privacy_workflow_owner']::text[] END),
      (to_regprocedure('public.get_current_privacy_eligibility()'), ARRAY['privacy_workflow_owner','authenticated']::text[]),
      (to_regprocedure('public.get_privacy_eligibility_for_user(uuid)'), ARRAY['privacy_workflow_owner','service_role']::text[])
    ) AS expected_function(function_oid, allowed_grantees)
    LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid = expected_function.function_oid
    WHERE expected_function.function_oid IS NULL
      OR NOT p.prosecdef
      OR p.proconfig IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['search_path=']
      OR pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) <> 'privacy_workflow_owner'
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl, acldefault('f', p.proowner))) acl
        LEFT JOIN pg_roles grantee ON grantee.oid = acl.grantee
        WHERE acl.privilege_type <> 'EXECUTE'
          OR COALESCE(grantee.rolname, 'PUBLIC') <> ALL(expected_function.allowed_grantees)
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM unnest(expected_function.allowed_grantees) allowed_grantee
        WHERE NOT has_function_privilege(allowed_grantee, p.oid, 'EXECUTE')
      )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles
    WHERE rolname = 'privacy_workflow_owner'
      AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolinherit AND NOT rolcreaterole AND NOT rolcreatedb
      AND NOT rolcanlogin AND NOT rolreplication AND NOT rolbypassrls
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_auth_members m
    WHERE m.roleid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'privacy_workflow_owner')
       OR m.member = (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'privacy_workflow_owner')
  )

)::text;

expectedPriorState.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'g016_freshness_prior_state',
  to_regprocedure('public.confirm_privacy_onboarding(uuid,text,uuid,text,uuid)') IS NOT NULL
  AND to_regprocedure('privacy_retention.g014_confirm_privacy_onboarding_legacy(uuid,text,uuid,text,uuid)') IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policy p JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = p.polrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'privacy_retention' AND c.relname = 'privacy_audit_events'
      AND p.polname = 'g016_privacy_workflow_owner_access'
      AND (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'privacy_workflow_owner') = ANY (p.polroles)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'privacy_retention' AND c.relname = 'privacy_audit_events'
      AND pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) = 'privacy_workflow_owner' AND c.relrowsecurity AND c.relforcerowsecurity
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_auth_members m WHERE m.roleid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'privacy_workflow_owner')
  )
)::text;
